environment.php_limits: 128M for small/medium,512M for large comparison harness; no product setting change
environment.cache: warm PHP/SQLite/OS; no forced cold-cache or vacuum

oracle: Actual recorded, field-rule-valid fifty snapshots; compared independently to every reconstruction. Only revision metadata.updated_at normalized after erasure. Ordered relations and schema identities remain exact.
statistics: 250 deterministic bootstrap resamples; descriptive median95percent intervals. Read/list n25, restore n3 (exploratory), erasure/migration n1; edits1000 include pruning and heterogeneous edits. No autocorrelation or host-distribution model.
limits: Synthetic authorable histories, not a measured production workload distribution.
SQLite only; PHP8.5 local. No floor, server-engine, power-loss or concurrent-writer qualification.

Prototype diffs object keys and replaces complete strings/ordered lists. Its list/erasure loops repeat per-version replay; no optimized streaming decoder, text-diff, compression or metadata sidecar comparison.
Current application and prototype codec/SQLite write timings have different work scopes; do not divide them as production speedup.
Prototype guarded restore uses a temporary full row and the current snapshot recorder; no production diff-write integration.
Staged migration retains old snapshots and demonstrates per-entry restart only; online cutover and multi-entry orchestration remain unimplemented.
